tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Starter value (the source has no palette). Page background for Translate, Learn, History and Settings. Text on it: `ink` 14:1, `ink-muted` 6:1, `accent` and the status colors 5.1:1 or more, in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, dictionary entries, banners, the subtitle panel. Holds every text token at 4.5:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells that hold something other than text flow: the camera preview frame, code and error-code chips, disabled picker rows. Text on it keeps 5.1:1 or more.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkbox, picker, banners) and dividers that carry meaning. 3.5:1 or more against all three surfaces in both themes. Never for decoration at lower strength.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and the live subtitle line on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`: captions, confidence values, alternatives, timestamps, helper text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Starter value, not a source brand color. Primary action fill, links and the selected state. As text it holds 5:1 or more on all three surfaces. Never used for status.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an `accent` fill (6.5:1 light, 9.2:1 dark). Dark text in the dark theme because the accent lightens there.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, drawn with a 2px offset so it lands on a surface and never on an accent fill. 5.2:1 or more on all three surfaces.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Ready, loaded, saved. A blue, not a green, so it parts from `status-danger` by hue as well as by its icon and word. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`: 5.1:1 or more.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Informational trouble that does not stop the user: server overloaded and dropping frames, a language marked non-commercial. Text on all three surfaces: 5.1:1 or more.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Blocking trouble: model unavailable, socket closed, upload rejected. Always shown with an icon and a word. Text on all three surfaces: 5.3:1 or more.

families.sans: "Golos Text", system-ui, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Arial, sans-serif
families.display: "Geologica", "Golos Text", system-ui, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: The live phrase from sign recognition and the speech subtitles. Set in `display` on `surface-raised` in `ink`. Largest text in the product: it is read at a glance while looking at the other person.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title on Translate, Learn, History and Settings.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and card headings, including sign language names shown in their own script.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text, dictionary words, history entries, banner messages.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines: English names, helper text, alternatives under a recognized sign.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Labels, category tags (letter, word, phrase), confidence values. Smallest size allowed; set in `ink-muted` or `ink`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: API error codes and ids shown in diagnostics, on `surface-sunken`. Never the only explanation of an error.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; inside caption tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related lines (a word and its alternatives); chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card and banner padding; gap between controls in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; padding of the subtitle panel.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, code badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, banners, picker rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the camera preview frame, the subtitle panel.
